reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Strengthening Public Financial Management Institutions in Burundi

description.narrative:
The five year CD program will help Burundi address the weaknesses in their PFM systems and processes, identified by the IMF mission in November 2022 and the EU-financed PEFA undertaken in 2023, and any other issues that may arise over the duration of the program. Burundi being a fragile state, the program will allow for flexibility in topics while ensuring consistency with priority reforms and proper sequencing.


The program will improve budget execution efficiency, and strengthen transparency in fiscal reporting and fiscal governance. Activities will focus inter alia on (i) developing a PFM strategy and related action plan; (ii) reinforcing the mechanisms for expenditure control and reporting; (iii) strengthening cash flow planning and forecasting; and (iv) strengthening PFM governance and fiscal transparency practices, including improving fiscal risks management. Where needed, the CD will also raise awareness on the use of digital technology to increase the efficiency of fiscal operations as well as the green/gender budgeting practices.


The program will combine training and technical assistance (TA) through the presence of an Long term, Head Quarters and Short Term missions to meet the authorities needs and priority requests. The missions schedule will be discussed with the authorities as needed.
